1. **Duplicated rule.** The "name is required" check is written out twice. `assertExecuteRule(dto)` in `create-project-use-case.ts` holds it as a shared exported function. `CreateUserUseCase.execute` in `create-user-use-case.ts` repeats the same check inline: `typeof dto.name !== "string" || dto.name.trim() === ""` followed by `throw new ValidationError("name is required")`. It does not call the shared function.

2. **Mixed concern.** `ListTasksUseCase` in `list-tasks-use-case.ts` has a method `validateExecute(dto: CreateProjectDto)` that calls `assertExecuteRule` from the create-project use case. Validating project creation does not belong in a use case that lists tasks. It pulls another use case's rule into this class and couples it to `CreateProjectDto`, which goes against the one-use-case-per-file structure the rest of the module follows.
